notes:
Whoever is given Training can now run it.

The Training switch on the Permissions screen opens the whole module, not a
read-only copy of it: book a session, set the dates and the times it runs
between, add the people attending, edit it, cancel it. A Super Admin can give
it to any account, whatever its role — the person who organises training is as
often a department lead as HR. An L&D Manager has it without being given it.

Picking who attends works for them too. It used to need the staff directory,
which only admin roles could read, so anyone else could open the form and find
nobody to add.

Training sessions carry a time.

A session runs from a moment to a moment rather than just on a day — pick the
date and the time it starts and ends, and the list shows both. A session with
no time set still reads as a plain date. It can no longer be saved ending
before it starts.

Alerts: swipe a card.

Swipe left to mark one read without opening it. Swipe right to delete it —
that one asks first, because it is the only thing on that screen you cannot
undo from the screen itself. An alert you have already read has nothing under
a left swipe, and only one card opens at a time.

Alerts you have read are cleared for you a week later, so the list stays the
things you still have to look at. Unread ones are never removed.
